svg.title: Time-forced switch: state and residence time
svg.desc: Fast and Slow alternate every half-period. x1 and x2 decay continuously; the residence-time metadata rises to the dwell time and restarts at zero on each new visit. Dashed vertical segments show exact event ages, not physical state jumps.
